name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.logScale_le_two_logScale_sub
type: ∀ {N b : ℕ}, 2 ≤ N - b → ↑N ≤ 2 * ↑(N - b) → TimeProfile.logScale N ≤ 2 * TimeProfile.logScale (N - b)

name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau_sub_le_two_tau
type: ∀ {N b : ℕ}, 0 < N → ↑N ≤ 2 * ↑(N - b) → RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau (N - b) ≤ 2 * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N

name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_residual_budgets
type:
∀ (c C D : ℝ),
  0 < c →
    ∀ (b0 M0 : ℕ),
      ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
        b0 < N0 ∧
          2 ≤ N0 ∧
            ∀ N ≥ N0,
              ∀ b ≤ b0,
                b < N ∧
                  2 ≤ N - b ∧
                    M0 ≤ N - b ∧
                      2 * ↑b ≤ c * ↑N ∧
                        ↑N ≤ 2 * ↑(N - b) ∧
                          TimeProfile.logScale N ≤ 2 * TimeProfile.logScale (N - b) ∧
                            RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau (N - b) ≤ 2 * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N ∧
                              RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N ≤ 1 / 2 ∧
                                D * (C * TimeProfile.logScale N + 1) * ↑b0 / ↑N ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N

name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.residual_selected_piles
type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (p : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K)
  (residual : TimeProfile.Cuts k (N - b) K),
  (∀ (j : Fin K) (a : Fin k), residual.count j a = cuts.count j a - RiffleLowerV2.usedCount p j a) →
    ∀ {c : ℝ},
      0 < c →
        2 * ↑b ≤ c * ↑N →
          (∀ (j : Fin K), c * ↑N ≤ ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get w j))) →
            ∀ (j : Fin K), c / 2 * ↑(N - b) ≤ ↑(residual.count j (List.Vector.get w j))
